description: List records from a SuperhotGeo public collection. "trending" = the ranked front-page board of what the field is paying attention to right now (recomputed every 6h from recent saves/views + recency), each row carrying its rank, type, refId, and a one-line label; "projects" = superhot/next-gen geothermal projects & regions; "pioneers" = people & orgs; "vendors" = drilling/subsurface marketplace; "testbeds" = shared field labs & open data; "lessons" = hard-won field lessons; "conferences" = geothermal conferences & summits worldwide, kept current; "exchange" = supply/RFQ/group-buy board; "offtake" = power↔demand board; "datasets" = open geothermal datasets; "artifacts" = RockLab models, datasets, and benchmarks with versions, licenses, provenance, metrics, and reproducibility status; "insights" = cross-connections; "problems" = hard open engineering problems the SuperhotGeo Reasoning Engine works on, each with a reasoned answer; "field_data" = the vetted field/well dataset (measured temperatures, depths, lithology, rates, and what failed at superhot conditions).
name: list_resource
